issues.description: The addRating(stars:) method has a return-type mismatch between artifacts: the template declares it as returning Void (no return type) while the solution implements it as returning Bool to indicate success/failure. The problem statement describes the behavior but does not specify a return type, which leaves students uncertain. This mismatch can cause compilation/test failures if tests (or the reference solution) expect a Bool result.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method signature consistent across artifacts. Either update the template to declare addRating(stars:) -> Bool (and return true/false as in the solution) or update the solution/tests and problem statement to explicitly specify a Void return. Preferably, change the template signature to func addRating(stars: Int) -> Bool and implement/describe that it returns true when a valid rating is added and false otherwise.
